regions.operational_promise: Carry a named obligation while a blockade closes the road behind the fortress.
regions.settlement_tradeoff: A kept convoy promise funds two Morrowline services; refusal leaves one.
regions.route_hazard: Blockade pressure changes visibility and can close the exposed signal road.
regions.threat_lesson: Cargo access and spatial dependency exposure.
regions.recovery_implication: Morrowline service capacity depends on the convoy outcome.

regions.operational_promise: Carry medicine through rising water while protecting lower-hull integrity.
regions.settlement_tradeoff: An operational medicine carrier earns a second Evacuation Camp service.
regions.route_hazard: Water pressure closes Drowned Registry but opens a guaranteed gantry recovery road.
regions.threat_lesson: Flood control, mass, and lower-hull protection.
regions.recovery_implication: Evacuation Camp service capacity depends on the medicine carrier.

regions.operational_promise: Climb volcanic grades while mass, heat, and a forge dynamo compete for margin.
regions.settlement_tradeoff: Delivering the dynamo earns two Old Lift services; refusal preserves flexibility but leaves one.
regions.route_hazard: Inferno pressure closes Slag Tunnel and opens Ash Chapel Bypass.
regions.recovery_implication: Old Lift refit must shed mass or strengthen the upper-grade counter.

regions.operational_promise: Cross open salt with an exposed signal line and a visible rival convoy.
regions.settlement_tradeoff: Windbreak recovery trades scarce water, contract trust, and chassis geometry.
regions.route_hazard: The ash front changes open routes and makes visibility itself a target.
regions.threat_lesson: Signal, command, medical, ammunition, and lower-hull counter chains.
regions.recovery_implication: Windbreak refit commits the Salt Skimmer to a signal, medical, or demolition answer.
